notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.3.4 adds a Back to Lead option to each Desktop Client card for accidental client conversions. It removes the Client record while keeping the linked Lead and restoring the stage it had before Add as Client marked it Won. Future conversions remember both the native Lead stage and Browser CRM sales stage; older conversions fall back to the Lead timeline. The shortcut refuses to run when real client delivery, sales, payment, portal, hosting, SEO, feedback, file, handoff or other linked client data exists, so established client work is not silently orphaned. Add as Client now keeps stage and sales_stage aligned at Won, and rollback restores both so the existing Supabase sync reflects the change. Browser CRM remains V4.3 and existing leads, projects, websites, Supabase sync, messaging, Twilio, Finder and updater behaviour are preserved.
